description: This file defines the Draggable class for making DOM elements draggable with touch and mouse support, used internally in the Leaflet mapping library.

classes.name: Draggable
classes.description: A class for making DOM elements draggable, supporting touch and mouse events, used internally in Leaflet for map and marker dragging.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Draggable with the element, optional drag handle, outline prevention, and options.

methods.name: _onDown
methods.description: Handles the start of a drag operation, setting up event listeners and initial positions.

methods.name: _onMove
methods.description: Handles the movement during dragging, updating element position.

methods.name: _updatePosition
methods.description: Updates the position of the element during dragging.

methods.name: _onUp
methods.description: Handles the end of a drag operation, cleaning up event listeners.

methods.name: finishDrag
methods.description: Finalizes the drag, fires 'dragend' event, and resets state.
